description: The carry register (Jess Haley, 2026-10-26, V_eta_go_forward_class_audit.md [carry register], with the kind `needs_mapping` from [one correct reading]): every reason the generic migration carries a v1 document whole as v1 is one row here, so that a carry is never read as "V2 is missing a field". A row names the v1 class (`*` for a reason that can hit any class, [renames carry is temporary]), its field(s), when the carry happens, its kind and the decision (document and tag). Kinds: `awaiting_home` (V2 should model it; `open_work` names the OPEN_WORK row, which must be open ([awaiting home is tracked]), and `home` says what the home is), `needs_mapping` (the v1 document admits several readings; `homes`, `decides`, `resolved_by` name the V2 homes, what decides between them and the dataset map entry that resolves it), `not_modelled` (V2 models it elsewhere or not at all, by design; `do_not` is the line a class must not contradict: `class` must not declare any of `fields`), `malformed` (input no writer produces). Checked by tools/check_carry_register.py. Every carry note a migrator writes is to cite its row (Build pending: DID-matlab, NDI-matlab). `kind_basis`: `stated` when the decision line gives the kind; `decided` when Claude read it from the line and the team confirmed it ([carry register kinds], [carry register kinds 2]); `proposed` when Claude read it and the team has not confirmed it (Proposed, not decided).
